#84913 106 2005-07-20T20:44:30Z Starcrossed
Its worth it if you bother to read it. Very funny. Its not mine though, thats why its copied and pasted.

Quote
Office Dares
Thing to keep you occupied at the office while you avoid work !


ONE-POINT DARES

1. Run one lap around the office at top speed

2. Groan out loud in the toilet cubicle (at least one other 'non-player' must be in the toilet at the time).

3. Ignore the first five people who say 'good morning' to you.

4. Phone someone in the office you barely know, leave your name and say, Just called to say I can't talk right now. Bye."

5. To signal the end of a conversation, clamp your hands over your head.

6. When someone hands you a piece of paper, finger it, and whisper huskily, Mmmmmmm, that feels soooooo good!"

7. Leave your zipper open for one hour. If anyone points it out, say, "Sorry, I really prefer it this way".

8. Walk sideways to the photocopier.

9. While riding in a lift, gasp dramatically every time the doors open.



THREE-POINTS DARES

1. Say to your boss, "I like your style" and shoot him with double-barrelled fingers.

2. Babble incoherently at a fellow employee then ask, "Did you get all that, I don't want to have to repeat it".

3. Page yourself over the intercom (do not disguise your voice).

4. Kneel in front of the water cooler and drink directly from the nozzle (there must be a 'non-player' within sight).

5. Shout random numbers while someone is counting.



FIVE POINT DARES

1. At the end of a meeting, suggest that, for once, it would be nice to conclude with the singing of the national anthem - (extra points if you actually launch into it yourself).

2. Walk into a very busy person's office and while they watch you with growing irritation, turn the light switch on/off 10 times.

3. For an hour, refer to everyone you speak to as "Bob".

4. Announce to everyone in a meeting that you "really have to go do a number two".

5. After every sentence, say 'mon' in a really bad Jamaican accent. As in "the report's on your desk, mon". Keep this up for one hour.

6. While an office mate is out, move their chair into the lift.

7. In a meeting or crowded situation, slap your forehead repeatedly and mutter, "Shut up, damn it, all of you just shut up!"

8. At lunchtime, get down on your knees and announce, "As God is my witness, I'll never go hungry again."

9. In a colleague's diary, write in 10am: "See how I look in tights".

10. Carry your keyboard over to your colleague and ask "You wanna trade?"

11. Repeat the following conversation 10 times to the same person:
Do you hear that?" "What?" "Never mind, it's gone now".

12. Come to work in army fatigues and when asked why, say, "I can't talk about it".

13. Posing as a maitre d', call a colleague and tell him he's won a lunch for four at a local restaurant. Let him go.

14. Speak with an accent (French, German, Porky Pig, etc) during a very important conference call.

15. Find the vacuum and start vacuuming around your desk.

16. Hang a two-foot long piece of toilet roll from the back of your pants and act genuinely surprised when someone points it out.

17. Present meeting attendees with a cup of coffee and biscuit, smash each biscuit with your fist.

18. During the course of a meeting, slowly edge your chair towards the door.

19. Arrange toy figures on the table to represent each meeting attendee, move them according to the movements of their real-life counterparts.


And if that wasn't enough for you - here are some examples of insane acts you can use anywhere...

1. At lunchtime, sit in your parked car with sunglasses on and point a hairdryer at passing cars. See if they slow down.

2. Tell your children over dinner. "Due to the economy, we are going to have to let one of you go."

3. Every time someone asks you to do something, ask if they want fries with that.

4. Put your rubbish bin on your desk and label it "IN."

5. Put decaf in the coffee maker for 3 weeks. Once everyone has gotten over his or her caffeine addictions, switch to espresso.

6. In the subject field for all your e-mails, write " FOR SEXUAL FAVOURS".

7. Finish all your sentences with "In accordance with the prophecy."

8. Don't use any punctuation

9. As often as possible, skip rather than walk.

10. Ask people what sex they are. Laugh hysterically after they answer.

11. Specify that your drive-through order is "to go."

12. Sing along at the opera.

13. Go to a poetry recital and ask why the poems don't rhyme.

14. Put mosquito netting around your work area. Play a tape of jungle sounds all day.

15. Five days in advance, tell your friends you can't attend their party because you're not in the mood.

16. Have your co-workers address you by your wrestling name, Rock Hard.

17. When the money comes out of the ATM, scream "I Won! I Won! 3rd time this week!!!"

18. When leaving the zoo, start running towards the parking lot yelling, Run for your lives, they're loose!"

EDIT: My fave is 10. "Carry your keyboard over to your colleague and ask "You wanna trade?" "

Quote
Some users were generally unimpressed with Windows Me, due to perceived stability issues. These issues generally came from using incompatible drivers, usually Windows 95 and 98 based drivers untested in Windows Me. In many instances separate ME compatible drivers were required as well as updates to mainboard BIOSes for proper compatibility. Microsoft's removal of legacy ISA support led to further confusion when older ISA based modems, soundcards and network cards failed to work. Proponents of Windows Me state that, using properly tested/certified drivers/hardware and BIOS updates (if necessary), Windows Me could be as stable as, if not more than, Windows 98SE.

From the Wikipedia article I cited during my Defense Of Windows Me.

「蟹工船」という名の料理店に行った。もちろん名前に惹かれて行ったのである。行ってみると、そこは入口に活蟹の水槽なども置かれたシックなたたずまいの高級蟹料理店だった。

　そりゃまあ「蟹工船」とて、もとはといえば一般名詞。料理店名になってもおかしくはない。ないがしかし、ここから小林多喜二の名を連想しない人はいないはずだし、読んでいなくても『蟹工船』が悲惨な労働現場を描いたプロレタリア文学であるのは日本の常識。

Though you don't live next door,
though you're five states away,
You're still here in my thoughts
every week, every day.

When events of the day
cause this soul to despair,
just the sound of your voice
makes them easy to bear.

When I don't have the luxury
of feeling your soft touch
or taking in your scent,
which I appreciate so much,

I need only look back
at the times we have had
to wonder if I've
any right to be sad.

You're truly a blessing.
I want you to know
that I care for you deeply,
wherever I go.

#128729 230 2005-12-31T11:42:27Z Solarion
You First Freighter.
Players start off trading energy and food and them move on to Hi tech goods. After that you can move on to weapons and very expensive goods. Trading food is nothing like trading Hi Tech goods and trading Hi tech goods is nothing like trading weapons. For starts you can make a living out of trading solely in any one of those areas, which was impossible in X2. But the requirements and the funding needed to do it increases when you start trading in new items. So lets look at the basic requirements for each of those areas.


Idiots guide to buying and selling prices.


If your not good at figures, always buy from factories that are fully stocked and always sell to factories that are empty. This will give you maximum profits with every trade run you make.


Food and Energy Trader Requirements.


Starting Freighter, 20,000 Credits to get a good first load of energy.


Hi Tech Trader Requirements.


Starting Freighter 500,000 credits to buy a good load of Hi tech wares plus 1 jump drive


Arms Dealer Requirements.


Starting Freighter, 1 million Credits plus a jump drive and a very good knowledge of the universes Equipment Docks.


Path to Profit.
When new players start playing X3 they will naturally begin to exploit holes in the economy and their profits will increase rapidly. Soon they will have enough to buy weapons on mass and at that point they will need to leave Argon space and trade around the universe. Effectively becoming Universal Arms Dealers. Whilst making 30k from the sale of Food and Energy (including costs) seems good at first, to an Arms dealer that's the profit he gets from selling 1 weapon. Considering most weapons take up less than 10 units of your cargo hold. Can you imagine how many weapons would be needed to fill it up completely and how much your cargo would be worth ?


I know what your thinking, why bother with food, why not go for weapons first. Well you do not have cash for starters and your reputation is too low as well. But once you have a high enough reputation with one race to buy high priced weapons, you should be able to sell them any where you can dock.


Just so you know, its extremely easy to spend over 16 million credits buying weapons to sell on. Such cargos usually hold a mixture of weapons, shields and ammo to fill your hold. That way you can usually sell several different types of weapons at each and every Equipment dock you visit. Making your profits per stop run in to the millions, but you cannot do this by sticking to the central Argon sectors. You must get out there and map out all the factories, all the sectors and all the Equipment docks.


Food and Energy Trader.


Tradable Goods = Energy and most food types.
Profits = between 10,000 and 300,000 per full cargo hold.
Type of Market = Local usually.


Hi Tech Trader.


Tradable Goods = Microchips, Satellites, Computer components, drones, crystals etc.
Profits = between 50,000 and 1000,000 per full cargo hold.
Type of Market = Universal Market for most products.


Arms Dealer.


Tradable Goods = Weapons, Shields, Ammo
Profits = between 200,000 and 5000,000 per full cargo hold.
Type of Market = Universal Market for most products.

Xevious and Friends
Issuse2: Meet Meh Friends and meh!


Yos! Its Xevious again as you know I told you a tiny bit about my self and zip about meh friends. So today Ill take the time to let you in on a little info about them. Have fun!


Profile: Xevious
Age: 17
Birth Date: May 7, 1988
Birth Place: Prower Village
Sex: Male
Height: 55
Weight: 135 pounds
Eye Color: Hazel
Hair Color: Silver Grey
Blood Type: Unknown
Abilities: Winged flight, Transforming into angel or demon, Uber speed, Magic.
Likes: Fishing, Hanging out with friends, Sparring, Break Dancing, Punk rock, Pie.
Dislikes: Losing at Socom3, twisting his ankle, getting pnwed at Halo2, people who sucker punch.
Personal motto: Bring it on! Ill take everyone down!
Other: Xevious is Leader of group. He mostly spends his time sleeping or playing Socom3 or Halo2.

Hey, So far you everything me! Have fun reading about everyone else!


Profile: Kojima-Miku
Age: 17
Birth Date: December 31, 1988
Birth Place: Hill Side Town
Sex: Female
Height: 51
Weight: 140 Pounds
Eye Color: Green
Hair Color: Blue
Blood Type: ZX
Abilities: Reading peoples minds, becoming invisible, Hacking computers, keeping secrets.
Likes: Cake, Sitting in trees, taking naps, not telling anybody anything that is personal.
Dislikes: Being poked, being told to shut up, people who keep asking about personal things, and other stuff.
Personal Motto: Dont say a word and theyll never find out
Other: Kojima-Miku is the secret keeping member of the group. She can keep any secrets you tell she and she is also a great fighter.

Profile: Mighty

Birth Date: July 4, 1900

Sex: Male
Height: 45
Weight: 110 Pounds
Eye Color: Grey
Hair Color: Black
Abilities: Unknown
Likes: Unknown
Dislikes: Unknown
Personal Motto: I take everything head on!
Other: Little is known about Mighty. He has no memory of his past only the destruction of his village.


Profile: Tails
Age: 14
Birth Date: June 1, 1991
Birth Place: Haver Town
Sex: Male
Height: 46
Weight: 100 pounds
Eye Color: Blue
Hair Color: Brown
Abilities: Summoning, Kicking Xevious ass at Halo 2, Two tailed flight, Using his blade.
Likes: Kicking Xevious ass at Halo2, Reading, building things, Computers.
Dislikes: People pulling his tails, People stepping on his tails, His computer crashing, losing his shoes.
Personal Motto: Havent thought of one yet
Other: Tails is the smartest one of the group and has a nack for building planes and weapons.

#152389 309 2006-03-06T21:42:43Z Rincewind SW
Find the radius of the bottom of the glass and square it then multiply it by pi. Then find the radius of the top of the glass and square it and multiply it by pi. Find the mean of these 2 values. Find the height of the glass and multiply it by the mean you just found, and your answer should be in(whatever units you used, I suggest millimetres), cubed. So mm^3. Got this? Good.

Now you need a way to find the volume of a drop... very hard imo since it''s no set value. Assume it is 1mm^3. Now simply divide the total volume by how big your drop is., so the volume in mm^3 is about the amount of drops in the glass.

One day two ninjas decided to go out to the shooting range and kill their banana's evil half-brother who was unicycling over an abyss. Suddenly, 469,000 pubescent gorillas came out of Hell asking for their adeptness. Tobias, the head gorilla, wielded moldy olive loaves with intent to annihilate Linus Ferguson, everyone's favorite bulemic undertaker. This wasn't saying much for Linus, because he was the only bulemic undertaker in the history of the world. Tobias was only throwing phones at the great big evil half-brother, who swiftly called collect. Suddenly the telephone exploded. Then the younger ninja became happy and he toilet-papered every living relative.

An antidisestablishmentarian passing nearby thought that stepping on the top of your head was utterly inappropriate

#158937 318 2006-03-28T18:51:38Z CDotLeach
As well as paying online, by SMS text message from your mobile phone, at selected shops, petrol stations and car parks, or by post, you can also pay your congestion charge by telephone. The charge is 8 if you pay by 10.00pm on the day of travel. An additional 2 surcharge will apply if you pay from 10.00pm until midnight on the day of travel. The total charge for paying between 10pm and midnight is 10. This is to encourage early payment.

#163085 341 2006-04-08T11:52:53Z JeCa
Let's see then...

Quote
En cykel krver sin frare. Den vlter om ingen sitter p och balanserar, men nd kan den bde framfras och styras. Detta var en av brderna Wrights viktigaste insikter och en bidragande orsak till att de lyckades bli frst med att flyga ett motordrivet flygplan fr precis 100 r sedan. Det skedde i Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, USA.
Triumfens gonblick r fngat av John Daniels i en klassisk bild. Den visar Flyer 1 nr den just lyft frn sin startrls. Orville Wright r ombord och Wilbur Wright springer bakom. Planet flg knappt 40 meter.
Att erfarenheterna frn cykeltillverkningen hade avgrande inverkan r en tanke som lyfts fram av Peter Jakab vid National Air and Space Museum i boken Taking Off: A Century of Manned Flight.
Ett drag som utmrker mnga framgngsrika innovatrer r teknikverfring. Man utnyttjar kunskaper inom ett omrde och applicerar dem p ett nytt. Enligt Peter Jakab finns det mnga exempel p teknikverfring i brderna Wrights arbete. Till exempel var det naturligt fr cykeltillverkarna att kraftverfringen mellan motorns vxellda och propellern skulle ske med kugghjul och kedja.
Att jmfra styrningen av en cykel med ett flygplan r en mer subtil men kanske viktigare parallell. Andra samtida flygdesigner anstrngde sig fr att komma upp i luften - att styra var ett senare problem. De frskte oftast bygga stabila flygplan, det vill sga farkoster som likt luftballonger klarar sig utan pilot.
Brderna Wright jmfrde med en cykel och insg att problemen hngde samman. De tillmtte drmed piloten en viktigare uppgift, han eller hon skulle inte bara styra planet p rtt kurs, piloten skulle ocks kontrollera att planet hll sig rtt i luften.
17 december 1903
Den 17 december 1903 genomfrde brderna Wright fyra flygningar. Frst lttade Orville frn startrlsen och flg 37 meter, drefter flg Wilbur drygt 50 meter. S var det ter Orvilles tur, som nu flg 60 meter och sist den dagen flg Wilbur 260 meter och hll sig d i luften i 59 sekunder.
Att de flg just den hr dagen var ingen slump. Till viss del berodde det p att det blste kraftigt, 10-12 meter per sekund, men framfr allt berodde det lyckade frsket p frarbetet.
Medan deras medtvlare gjorde nrmast slumpmssiga frsk gick brderna Wright betydligt mer kontrollerat och systematiskt till vga. Deras lyckade frsk i december 1903 utgr en milstolpe, framfr allt drfr att det kom att f en sdan inverkan p den fortsatta utvecklingen. Den teknik och de rutiner som brderna Wright utvecklade och anvnde nr det byggde sina flygplan kom att bli standarden. I princip gller de n i dag.
Brderna Wright sg flygplanet som ett tekniskt system. Det var inte en enskild uppfinning, utan flera olika, som alla mste utvecklas oberoende av varandra och sedan sttas samman till en fungerande helhet. Flygplanet mste ha vingar med tillrcklig lyftkraft men lgt luftmotstnd, det mste kunna styras i tre dimensioner, vara ltt men hllfast, ha en effektiv propeller och en stark men ltt motor. Inget av detta var tidigare gjort, och om man misslyckades med ett enda av alla dessa delproblem skulle flygplanet inte flyga.
Wilbur och Orville Wright tnkte sig propellern som en roterande vinge, men vnd p sidan s att lyftkraften verkar vertikalt. P detta vis kunde de anvnda data som de samlat fr sin vingkonstruktion och konstruera tv extremt effektiva propellrar. De liknade inga tidigare propellrar och bildade skola fr framtida propellerdesign.
Propellern r, enligt Peter Jakab, det bsta exemplet p brderna Wrights frmga att omstta tankemodeller till verkliga konstruktioner.
Vindtunneln behvdes
P senare r har datorer kommit att radikalt frndra arbetsmetoderna vid flygplansdesign. Det gr numera att berkna luftstrmmarna kring vingprofiler och andra flygplansdetaljer. Sjlva grundproblemet r dock detsamma som fr hundra r sedan: man vill knna flygplanets egenskaper innan man bygger det i full skala. Brderna Wright var bland de frsta att frst vikten av att genom vindtunnelfrsk systematiskt ta reda p dessa egenskaper.
Wilbur och Orville Wright uppfann visserligen inte vindtunneln. Den frsta byggdes antagligen redan 1871 av deras landsmn Francis Wenham och John Browning. Ytterligare ett drygt tiotal fregick den som brderna Wright byggde r 1901. Det var en enkel, 2 meter lng trlda med en flkt i ena nden. Det som gjorde experimenten unika var instrumenten de anvnde och det faktum att de anvnde dem fr att direkt f de data de behvde fr att konstruera sitt flygplan.
Nr brderna Wright pbrjade sitt flygprojekt i slutet av 1800-talet fanns egentligen redan ekvationer fr att berkna lyftkraft och vindmotstnd hos en given vinge. Aerodynamiska data fanns ocks insamlade fr olika lufttryck p vingytor vid olika attackvinkel, dvs vinkeln mot fartvinden. Till en brjan litade brderna Wright p data de ftt frn den tyske glidflygaren Otto Lilienthal. Med dem kunde de relativt enkelt rkna ut prestanda fr de tv glidflygplan som de byggde 1900 respektive 1901.
Nr de testade dem var dock vingarnas lyftkraft lngtifrn vad brderna hade hoppats p och vad deras berkningar hade frutsptt. De misstnkte att de data som de ftt frn Otto Lilienthal var felaktiga. Alla andra uppgifter kunde de enkelt mta sjlva, som flygplanets hastighet och vingarnas yta. Det logiska steget blev drfr att sjlva samla in de uppgifter som kunde erstta dem de misstnkte var felaktiga.
Efter att ha prvat med flera andra mtapparater fastnade brderna Wright fr vindtunneln. De instrument som de placerade inne i ldan anvndes fr att mta luftmotstnd och lyftkraft och utformades s att de kunde testa flera olika vingprofiler. Med dessa instrument erhll de en mngd mtdata, som vid senare kontroller med moderna metoder har visat sig hyfsat korrekta.
Den bsta glidaren
Merparten av frsken med vindtunneln utfrdes i slutet av 1901, och ett nytt glidflygplan baserat p de korrigerade uppgifterna byggdes 1902. Denna nya glidflygare var en klar frbttring gentemot de tidigare tv, och den motsvarade ocks brdernas frvntningar nr det gllde lyftkraft och luftmotstnd.
Peter Jakab gr s lngt att han beskriver vindtunneln och glidflygplanet som tv delar av en och samma innovation. Han menar att man inte kan frst flygplanet utan att ocks frst de sm mtinstrumenten i brdernas verkstad.
Forskningen i vindtunneln och resultaten frn provflygningarna ledde ocks till andra frbttringar av den tredje glidflygaren. Bland annat infrdes ett vertikalroder som tillsammans med vriga styrmjligheter gjorde att man nu fullt ut hade mjlighet att styra planet i alla tre dimensioner.
Redan i tidigare modeller hade brderna gjort frsk med en metod fr att styra flygplanet i sidled som de kallade vingskevning. Genom att vrida vingspetsarna i motsatta riktningar erhlls mer lyftkraft frn den ena vingen n den andra vilket i sin tur fick flygplanet att luta. Genom att kontrollera denna vridning kunde brderna Wright balansera planet eller luta det fr att inleda en svng.
Frsiktiga testflygare
Med sin tredje glidflygare hade brderna lst tre problem: aerodynamiken, styrningen och konstruktionen. Kvar var motorn och propellern.
Ngot som visar hur lngt gngen glidflygaren var r att nr brderna Wright skte patent 1906 gllde det inte det motordrivna flygplanet utan glidflygaren frn 1902.
Lika viktigt som modellfrsken i verkstaden var dock provflygningarna i full skala. Fred Culick, professor vid California Institute of Technology, kallar brderna Wright fr vrldens frsta flygingenjrer men ocks vrldens frsta testpiloter. Fred Culick har deltagit i bygget av en flygande kopia av Flyer 1, och dessutom utvrderat dess egenskaper i en vindtunnel.
I en utvrdering av deras arbetsinsats mtt med dagens kunskap noterar han att de visserligen saknade vissa grundlggande insikter om aerodynamik, men att de lyckades kompensera detta bland annat genom sina provflygningar. "Deras observationer och tolkningar av ett flygplans beteende i luften r enastende."
ven flygtestningen gick stegvis och frsiktigt till vga. Kanske bidrog Otto Lilienthals ddskrach 1896 till brderna Wrights noggrannhet (se rutan nedan). Likt moderna testflygningar utfrdes de systematiskt i serier, dr de hela tiden observerade och analyserade flygplanets beteende.
Brderna brukade frst flyga sina plan som drakar, obemannade, och drefter med en person ombord, men fortfarande kontrollerade frn marken som drakar. Och till sist flugna av en pilot. ven pilotflygningarna gick stegvis. Frst var pilotens kontrollmjligheter begrnsade, fr att sedan utkas. Allt fr att datainsamlingen skulle ske systematiskt.
Ytterligare ett skl till den stegvisa processen var att brderna Wright sjlva var tvungna att lra sig flyga. En konst som med deras instabila konstruktion innebar betydligt mer n att bara styra.
Frsta passagerarplanet
r 1905 hade brderna Wright byggt sitt tredje motordrivna flygplan: Flyer 3. Med det klarade de nu att starta, flyga kontrollerat i mer n en halvtimme och landa mjukt. Trots att utvecklingen inte skett i hemlighet valde de att vila p sina fynd, ska patent och frska slja sin id. Det drjde drfr tre r innan de terupptog provflygningarna.
r 1908 hade brderna Wright ftt patent och en frsta bestllning. De var nu tvungna att visa att de kunde ta med en passagerare. Ocks det ett rekord, nr de den 14 maj 1908 fr frsta gngen flg med en passagerare ombord. Ett r senare brjade de undervisa studenter i konsten att flyga.
Tillsammans med det omfattande forskningsarbetet, fotografierna, och dokumentationen, var dessa offentliga framtrdanden det som behvdes fr att befsta brderna Wrights position som de verkliga flygpionjrerna. Det finns de som hvdar att brderna Wright inte var frst. Men om det skulle vara sant r det nd mindre viktigt. Wilbur och Orville Wright var garanterat de frsta flygingenjrerna.

This file contains data used to fill the [User Levels] menu in N;
editing the contents of this file allows you to alter the contents of the in-game menu.
We recommend that you turn Word Wrap off to edit this file.


It's _very_ important that you format data properly when adding it to this file,
or who knows what will happen. Wait, I know: something bad.


To add a level to the list, simply add it into this file using the following syntax:

$levelname#authorname#comments#leveldata#

(it's _very_ important that you don't forget the final "#" after the level data!!)

The fields should be self-explanitory:
levelname: the name of the level, i.e "superliminal"
authorname: the name of the person who made the level, i.e "jimmy"
comments: you can use this field to describe the level type, i.e "easy", "hard", "boring", etc.
leveldata: data describing the level, usually taken from the level editor


Level and author names which contain "#" will produce errors.
You can add text between level data as long as it doesn't contain "$" or "#" characters. This is helpful

INTERNET EXPLORER FOR MAC NO LONGER AVAILABLE FOR DOWNLOAD

In June 2003, the Microsoft Macintosh Business Unit announced that Internet Explorer for Mac would undergo no further development, and support would cease in 2005. In accordance with published support lifecycle policies, Microsoft ended support for Internet Explorer for Mac on December 31st, 2005, and is not providing any further security or performance updates.

Accordingly, as of January 31st, 2006, Internet Explorer for the Mac is no longer available for download from Microsoft. It is recommended that Macintosh users migrate to more recent web browsing technologies such as Apple's Safari.

#218881 610 2006-08-23T20:24:59Z JeCa
Playtest. It's easy to playtest maps in Ned. Then you'll see what the problem is. For example, you can't jump straight up to the bounceblock at the right. It is possible to make that rocket pass you if you make a wall jump at the block, but it's very hard, and such things in the beginning of maps arent apprciated. Also It's very easy to get stuck at the right off the exit. I'd suggest moving the exit pillar some two tiles to the left so the you really can use the bottom floor if you've got problem shaking of those rockets. Also you didn't really think out a plan as to how to get up if you reach the bottom. And since both of the keys are over the ground with no b-blocks underneath them that can get very frustrating. I'd suggest that you think of a route in your head that you want people to take, and then playtest that route to make sure it works. After that you may add additional blocks to give the player options.
But I'd say start on a new level. This one's kinda dead IMO.

#238663 757 2006-10-09T06:05:57Z Grassman7z7
I was very young; only 4 or 5, at most, before either of my siblings were born. It was just Mommy and Daddy and me, living in our little house in Great Bend, Kansas. Very quaint. We were a young family, without much money, and most of our furniture was second-hand.

It was the middle of the day; summer, hot, boring. I was playing marbles by myself on the thin carpet beside the huge, old, flower-patterned-couch. Mom was down the hall in the kitchen, and Dad was at work.

Why I was trying to roll marbles around on the carpet I don't know - we had a perfectly good linoleum floor, after all. But there I was, swishing the marbles back and forth, happily bouncing them into each other. Then, in my overzealous enthusiasm, I rolled too hard. My favorite marble - the clear, ruby-red one, zipped into the dark space under the couch and was lost.

Damnit. Dad wasn't home, and he was the only one strong enough to move that huge old couch for me. I'd have to get my marble back myself.

I reached my hand under the couch, tentatively at first, then deeper. Encountering no marbles, I pulled my hand out in disappointment.

Then, a hand reached out from under the couch back at me.

I remember the image vividly, and I suspect I always will. It was a slim hand, with tapered fingers - a woman's hand. It was gnarled and wrinkled, as if aged, and it was dead black. Not black as in African, black as in dead. Of course, back then, I didn't know that corpses blacken as they decompose, so I didn't know what the black meant.

The hand reached out to me as far as it could, which was just up to the wrist. Then it retreated under the couch. Then it emerged again, this time pushing with it a little crumpled up, plastic bag with a logo on it I didn't recognize. It waited, as if expecting me to take the bag. Then, when I didn't, it pulled the bag back under the couch and was gone.

I got up, walked down to the kitchen, and told my Mommy what had happened.

Why didn't I run screaming, or at least run? I don't really know. All I can say is, I was a little kid; a hand reaching out from under the couch at me didn't seem like that huge a deal. I hadn't yet learned what was and was not permissible in reality. I had no worldview.

Mom was skeptical, but walked me back to the couch and explained how I was probably imagining things. She even reached her hand under the couch to convince me that nothing was down there. Later, Dad lifted the couch up for me, and the only thing under it was, of course, my missing marble, plus a few more marbles I didn't even remember losing.

But here's the scary part.

For years, I remembered this - I even developed a weird fantasy of little hand-people living under the couch, and I, in my childlike innocence, believed that they would catch me and take me away if I ever reached into their domain again. Then, as I grew older, I wrote the memory off as a dream I had had as a child - cute, but silly.

Then, a few years ago, I recounted the story to my mother.

She gave me a funny look, and told me she remembered it, because, after all, she had been there. She told me that she remembered me coming to her in the middle of the day and telling her about the hand under the couch, and remembered being highly disturbed by my story, since I was an extremely quiet, well-behaved kid who didn't ever lie.

Then she told me about the couch itself. According to her, she and Dad had gotten the couch from the estate of an old woman who had actually died on it. This was the first time I had heard about this, but it sure explained why they got rid of the couch within a month of my story.

But here's part that truly frightens me, even to this day. The part that I have to try so hard to get out of my mind some nights. Remember that bag the hand pushed towards me? I've never forgotten the logo that was on it. And, recently, (as in a few years ago), I saw the same logo again, on what looked like the same type of bag, in a hardware store.

It was a bag of utility razor-blades.

January - Took new scarf back to store because it was too tight.



February - Fired from pharmacy job for failing to print
labels.....Helllloooo!!!.....bottles won't fit in printer !!!



March - Got really excited.....finished jigsaw puzzle in 6
months.....box said "2-4 years!"



April - Trapped on escalator for hours ..... power went out!!!



May - Tried to make Kool-Aid....wrong instructions....8 cups of water
won't fit into those little packets!!!



June - Tried to go water skiing.....couldn't find a lake with a slope.



July - Lost breast stroke swimming competition....learned later, the
other swimmers cheated, they used their arms!!!



August - Got locked out of my car in rain storm.....car swamped because
soft-top was open.



September - The capital of California is "C".....isn't it???



October - Hate M &M's.....they are so hard to peel.



November - Baked turkey for 4 1/2 days ... instructions said 1 hour per
pound and I weigh 108!!



December - Couldn't call 911 ..... "duh".....there's no "eleven" button
on the stupid phone!!!

Quote: What I Had To Paste Last
Sweep and maestro,

I have a confession to make.

I think that the majority of the forums are a hypersensitive bunch of children. They've been turning the forums into fuckin' Oprah since I got back from work. Imagine my frustration when I get on and think to myself, "what the fuck is this shit?" And you know that when Suki says, "what the fuck is this shit," some extra-ordinary shit is definitely the fuck up.

"I... I have a confession to make, you guys."
*ambient conversation noise halts*
"I'm... I'm....... I'm a multiaccounter!" *sob*
*everyone runs to give deja a hug*
"I also have a confession to make, you guys!"
*everyone turns to Element*
"I'm a multiaccounter, too!" *sob*
*everyone, tears streaming from their faces, gives deja and Element a gropu hug*
"H-hey, guys..."
*everyone turns toward Jakel*

And on the fuck it goes.
Jesus Christ, do these people not understand the frequency of multiaccounting violations on NUMA? Do they even think they're making some sort of statement by confessing? If I were one of these multiaccounting losers, I'd just stop doing it and not make such a fuss about it. But nooo, their hypersensitive vaginas all want special attention for being so bold as to bandwagon-confess like cowards. Fuckers. They're attention-whoring more than Dave, even (whom you should fully expect to ride into the spotlight any minute now).

I guess it's not really fair of me to criticize a bunch of goddamned children for acting like goddamned children, but goddamnit, I fucking hate children.

This is my confession: I harbor great dislike for 80% of the active forumers.
Though I suppose I may as well confess that I'm not a boiled egg, while I'm preoccupying myself with 'confessing' the obvious.

Roses are red,
Violents are blue,
In all likelihood,
Suki hates you.

ban plz kthx

-Tsukatu

P.S. Please don't give me a warning for th- oh wait. Hahahahaha.

"Does not wood float?"
"......Yeah...Yeah, it floats!"
"Good! What else floats?"
"Berries!"
"Cider!"
"Very small rocks!"
"Lead!"
...
"A duck."
"right! So, logically, if she weighs the same as a duck..."
"She's made of wood!"
"And therefore..."
...
"A WITCH!!!"


"And that is how we know the earth to be banana shaped!"
"This new learning inspires me. Explain to me again how sheeps' bladders can be used to prevent earthquakes."


"What is your name?"
"Sir Lancelot!"
"What is your quest?"
"To seek the Holy Grail!"
"What... Is your favorite color?"
"Blue!"

"that's easy, I want to try!
"What is your name?"
"Sir Robin!"
"what is your quest?"
"To seek the Holy Grail!"
"What is the capital of Assyria?"
"...I don't know that. AAAAAAAAGH!!!!"

"What is your name?"
"Sir Galahad!"
"what is your quest?"
"To seek the Holy Grail!"
"What is your favorite color?"
"Blue. No, yel- AAAAAAAAAGH!!!!"

"What is your name?"
"I am Arthur, king of the Britons."
"what is your quest?"
"I seek the grail."
"What is the airspeed velocity of a swallow?"
"What do you mean, an African or a European swallow?"
"I don't know that... AAAAAAAAGH!!!!"

There's a lady who's sure all that glitters is gold

'Cause you know sometimes words have two meanings.
In a tree by the brook, there's a songbird who sings,
Sometimes all of our thoughts are misgiven.
Ooh, it makes me wonder,
Ooh, it makes me wonder.

There's a feeling I get when I look to the west,
And my spirit is crying for leaving.
In my thoughts I have seen rings of smoke through the trees,
And the voices of those who stand looking.
Ooh, it makes me wonder,
Ooh, it really makes me wonder.

And it's whispered that soon if we all call the tune
Then the piper will lead us to reason.
And a new day will dawn for those who stand long
And the forests will echo with laughter.

If there's a bustle in your hedgerow, don't be alarmed now,
It's just a spring clean for the May queen.
Yes, there are two paths you can go by, but in the long run
There's still time to change the road you're on.
And it makes me wonder.

Your head is humming and it won't go, in case you don't know,
The piper's calling you to join him,
Dear lady, can you hear the wind blow, and did you know
Your stairway lies on the whispering wind.

And as we wind on down the road
Our shadows taller than our soul.
There walks a lady we all know
Who shines white light and wants to show
How everything still turns to gold.
And if you listen very hard
The tune will come to you at last.
When all are one and one is all
To be a rock and not to roll.

And she's buying the stairway to heaven.

#369998 1206 2007-10-06T11:05:37Z writetyper
// ***********************************************************
//
// OBJECT: Health Box
//
// ***********************************************************

function itemConstruct(obj)
{
obj.setting.suspend=true;
obj.setting.pickUp=true;

// model

obj.model.on=true;
obj.model.name='Atom';
obj.model.lit=DIM3_MODEL_LIT_VERTEX;
obj.model.shadow.on=true;

// settings

obj.size.x=600;
obj.size.z=600;
obj.size.y=600;
}

//
// item pickup callback
//

function itemPickup(obj)
{
// pickup the item

sound.play("Got Ammo",obj.position.x,obj.position.z,obj.position.y,1);
obj.pickup.addHealth(obj.pickup.objectId,10000);
map.action.setMap('Fight 2','Start','Player');

// turn off pickups and fade out

obj.setting.contact=false;
obj.event.startTimer(1,0);
}

//
// item fades
//

function itemFadeOut(obj,tick)
{
obj.model.alpha-=0.1;
obj.model.resize-=0.08;
if (obj.model.alpha>0) return;

// all the way faded out

obj.model.alpha=0;
obj.setting.hidden=true;

// wait for fade in

obj.event.startTimer(50000000000000000000,1000000000000);
}

function itemFadeIn(obj,tick)
{
obj.model.alpha+=0.1;
obj.model.resize+=0.08;
if (obj.model.alpha<1) return;

// all the way faded in

obj.model.alpha=1;
obj.model.resize=1;

// ready for pickup

obj.setting.contact=true;
obj.event.clearTimer();
}

function itemRespawn(obj,tick)
{
// play teleport sound

sound.play("Got Ammo",obj.position.x,obj.position.z,obj.position.y,1);

// start fade in

obj.setting.hidden=false;

obj.event.startTimer(1,2);
}

function itemTimer(obj,id)
{
switch (id) {

case 0:
itemFadeOut(obj);
return;

case 1:
itemRespawn(obj);
return;

case 2:
itemFadeIn(obj);
return;

}
}

//
// item events
//

function event(obj,mainEvent,subEvent,id,tick)
{
switch (mainEvent) {

case DIM3_EVENT_CONSTRUCT:
itemConstruct(obj);
return;

case DIM3_EVENT_PICKUP:
itemPickup(obj);
return;

case DIM3_EVENT_TIMER:
itemTimer(obj,id);
return;


}
}

Τα μεγάλα gramps μου πέθαναν πάρα πολλής ηλικίας. Μετά από αυτόν ήταν χρόνος cristmas. τόσο luckly πήρε να γιορτάσει τα cristmas στον ουρανό. Έχω σχεδόν μια πλήρη στήλη των επεισοδίων που ολοκληρώνονται στο ν αλλά το ι can`t παίρνει μετά από 18-2. Χρειάζομαι ένα διαφορετικό σολ που παίρνει γίνοντα με αυτό. Μετά από αυτόν, θα πάρω χρωματισμένο το ελιά ninja μου. Έχω κάνει μερικά programms και PowerPoint παρουσιάζει και επίσης μερικοί δροσεροί κινηματογράφοι λάμψης. Infact, έχω μόνο ένα (ν) Α: δισκέτα, β: κίνηση και εναλλασσόμενο ρεύμα: τοπικός δίσκος. Θέλησα να έχω ένα φ: η κίνηση σύνδεσε αλλά θα ήταν πάρα πολύ σκληρή και εκτός αυτού, πού θα έπαιρνα την άλλη κίνηση από; Αυτό είναι ένα από τα probblems. Έχω προσέξει πολλά βίντεο ραβδιών σε www.stickpage.com και έχω παίξει όλα τα παιχνίδια. Προχωρήστε εκεί. Έχει το λαϊκός-UPS αλλά ακριβώς τους κλείνει. Το καλοκαίρι, θα έχω τα μέρη ΜΕΓΑΛΟΥ. ΑΣΧΗΜΟΣ. Τα ζωύφια στο δωμάτιό μου ο λόγος αυτός είναι επειδή έχω ένα ακατάστατο δωμάτιο και τα μέρη των τροφίμων παλιοπραγμάτων εδώ σε αυτό κάνουν τα ζωύφια να θελήσουν να ζήσουν εδώ. Χρειάζομαι ένα μπουκάλι Raid και το ψεκάζω σε όλη τη θέση. Αλλά ακόμα κι αν έκανα το δωμάτιό μου θα ήταν ακόμα πιό ακατάστατο λόγω του poisonus Raid άνω όλων των oom μου. Ι πραγματικά hte το σχολείο μου. Με κάνουν να περάσω εκεί Δευτέρα μέχρι την Παρασκευή και δεν μαθαίνω ποτέ τίποτα νέο. Ή εγώ; Μαθαίνω κάτι αλλά το ι dont ακριβώς το ξέρει. Αλλά αληθινός του. Δεν πρέπει να πάω στο σχολείο και να μάθω τίποτα. Παίρνω ολόκληρη μια ημέρα όber ακριβώς για να πάω στο σχολείο και να μην κάνω τίποτα. Κάνω έναν ιστοχώρο από πολλά έγγραφα HTML. Ένας από τους ελειτούργησε έναν από τους didn`t. Αλλά ο ιστοχώρος μου didn`t παίρνει μέχρι τώρα, πήρε διαγραμμένος. Αλλά τώρα χρησιμοποίησα PowerPoint για να κάνω τους ιστοχώρους όπου κανένας θα τους έβρισκε. Και έτσι, από τότε που διέγραψε ο ιστοχώρος μου που αποκτήθηκε, τους κράτησα σε έναν φάκελλο ΦΕΡΜΟΥΑΡ με έναν κωδικό πρόσβασης. Τώρα κανένας δεν μπορεί να τους πάρει... αλλά εσείς σκέφτεται ότι ο φάκελλος ΦΕΡΜΟΥΑΡ θα μπορούσε να πάρει διαγραμμένος; Αυτός θα ήταν κακός, ΠΟΛΥ κακός. Καλά, thats όλοι οι λαοί

This is a response to Lydia's inquiry, and your response.

First, I would like to make the point that jumping off a bridge is nothing akin to staying out late. Mainly, common sense dictates that you should not jump off a bridge. Whereas staying up and out late is a completely normal thing to do. You need to take the responsibility to not get into trouble.
Second, I would like to make a suggestion: no one in the household should hold supreme power and decide what the curfew is by themselves. I suggest that you two and your mother take some time to figure out a curfew that feels reasonable to ALL of you. For instance, if your mother doesn't want you out at five and you think twelve is too early agree on somewhere in between. Like three, or even two o-clock.
Third, in terms of boys not asking you out because of the early curfew deal; if they are that unwilling to make such a small personal sacrifice then they aren't worthy of being anyone's boyfriend.
And seriously, if your mother trusts you so little that she won't let you stay up late I would suggest counseling.

Name: Any name that you want
Nation: Theeds(Central)/Zimpergan(NW)/Augmence(SW)/Sarran(SE)/Avaelan(NE)
Description: What he/she looks like, and anything else that you want us to know about him/her.
Weapon: Any weapon that you want, really. But it has to be fairly generic. You can say Sword, but not 17' sword. Or you can have a laser blaster, but you can't say Black Hole Gun. Stuff like that.
Skills: 5 skills that your character has. Again, can't be super powerful and specific. Generic things, like is good at fighting, can use magic, loves ice cream. Remember, it's more so other people can write your characters and less about what powers they have.

#472349 1571 2008-09-22T02:49:23Z Riobe
Reversion

Hosted By: Riobe & TKS

There have been a lot of maps on NUMA as of late. There have been NReality maps, and regular maps. I've seen many of those, all over the place. What I haven't seen is maps that can be played in both. So this is TKS's as long as my plan. You guys will make maps that can both be played in NReality and Nv1.4.
Spoiler: Rules & Standards
  1. First off, all maps have to be possible to beat in both N v1.4 and NReality v6c2. No acceptions.
  2. Maps have to be different. There has to be a unique distinction between the normal map and the NReality map.
  3. Maps have to be posible to beat, as in playable and beatable. No survivals, N-Arts, and DDA's (Obviously) allowed, and will not be scored if submitted.
  4. Maps will have two different themes. One theme will be a tileset theme. The tiles will have to represent something. THe other theme will be the NReality Theme. This theme will represent a certain type of NReality map.
  5. This contest will be separated into rounds. In each round, a certain amount of peoplle will be eliminated based on how many people are in that current round.
  6. Maps may be submitted to NUMA or posted in this thread. If submitted on NUMA, post a link to it in this thread.
  7. I am open to suggestions for tileset themes.
  8. Any profanity, racism, sexism, etcetera will result in a ban from the contest, and possibly more drastic measures from a moderator.
  9. All maps must have the tag reversion.
  10. All maps must have a completion demo attatched to the level, whether posted to NUMA or in a text file.
  11. I will not accept submissions via PM at the moment.
  12. As there may be some competition, remember the main idea of this is to have fun.
Spoiler: JudgingJudging will be as follows:
  • Fun-How fun is the map. ?/20
  • Aesthetics-How good does it look. ?/20
  • NReality Theme-How well does it follow this theme. ?/15
  • Tileset Theme-How well does it follow this theme. ?/15
  • Replayability-Is it addicting, or after one try, does it make you not want to play it again. ?/15
  • Difference-How much of a difference is there in the two versions. ?/15
I'm definetly a judge. TKS might be a judge. I might need another judge anyways.
Spoiler: Prizes As of the moment, undecided. I'm open for suggestions on this too.
Spoiler: Contestants
Spoiler: MapsNone yet.

That's pretty much all of it. I'll need to fill the spots in for contestants, so please join ASAP.
------------------------
